<?xml version="1.0"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2011/08/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>DeCoAgentLib.Net</id>
    <version>0.0.0.6</version>
    <title>DeCoAgentLib.Net</title>
    <authors>Okan Topçu</authors>
    <owners>oToT</owners>
    <projectUrl>https://sites.google.com/site/okantopcu/decoagent</projectUrl>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <description>DeCoAgentLib.Net provides an application programming interface (API) for implementing the deliberative coherence-driven agent (DeCoAgent), which generates agent motivations and actions based on a theory of coherence derived from deliberative coherence.</description>
    <summary>DeCoAgentLib provides an application programming interface (API) for implementing the deliberative coherence-driven agent (DeCoAgent), which generates agent motivations and actions based on a theory of coherence derived from deliberative coherence.</summary>
    <releaseNotes>DeCoLib adaptation.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright © Okan Topcu 2015</copyright>
    <tags>Agent-based Simulation</tags>
    <dependencies>
      <dependency id="DeCoLib" version="0.0.0.3" />
      <dependency id="DeCoMeta" version="1.0.0.2" />
      <dependency id="CoMeta" version="0.0.0.1" />
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
